description: Source code for a video recording utility that generates synthetic video frames and encodes them into an MP4 file using Android's media framework. Includes a DummySource class for frame generation, command-line argument parsing, and media encoding setup.

classes.name: DummySource
classes.description: A media source that generates synthetic raw video frames for testing video encoding.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the video recording utility.

methods.name: DummySource::getFormat
methods.description: Returns metadata describing the raw video format.

methods.name: DummySource::read
methods.description: Generates and outputs a synthetic video frame, updating timestamp and frame count.
